column3: Do you think\nyou can stop me?{pause_20_skippable}{end_now}
Then why are you\nstill standing here?{end_wait}
I won't let you pass.\nReady yourselves.{end_wait}
I must finish this\nquickly... Come at me!{end_wait}
I'm going with\n{actor_name:1}. They need me.{end_wait}

Very well. Imil is in your\nhands, Megan, Justin.{end_wait}
